persona.text: What do you do, and what field are you in?
What do you want to be known for online?
What is one belief you hold that most people in your field disagree with?
Tell one real story from your career or life that shaped how you work.
What topics are completely off-limits for your account?
Which words or phrases do you never want to see in your tweets?
How competitive are you, and where does it show up?
What do you love reading or watching about (business, tech, sports...)?
Which topics should your tweets cover?
Paste 3-10 of your own past posts or writing (one per entry).
What do you admire about this account?

thinking.text: I prefer to check the data before forming an opinion.
I trust my gut more than a spreadsheet.
I break big problems into measurable parts.
I like ideas and frameworks more than concrete examples.
I explain things best with specific real cases.
I enjoy connecting unrelated fields into one theory.
I take bold bets even when the odds are unclear.
I avoid options where I could lose a lot.
I move first and fix later.
I enjoy arguing against the popular view.
I usually agree with expert consensus.
I get suspicious when everyone agrees.
I think about how people feel before what is correct.
Blunt truth matters more than comfort.

voice.a: Growth is a function of consistent, deliberate effort.
voice.b: you don't get better by vibes. you show up.

voice.a: Most founders underestimate how long distribution takes because they only see the launch, not the slow months of learning what people actually want.
voice.b: Distribution is slow. Launch is a myth. Learn first.

voice.a: Everyone says hustle harder. Wrong. Most people need to quit more.
voice.b: Hustle matters, but pick the right thing first.

voice.a: My roadmap is 90% things I promised in a meeting.
